title: A Beach Trip That Changed His Mind
paragraphs: Preferring cities to nature his entire life, Karim reluctantly agreed to a beach trip organized by his wife, expecting to spend most of the weekend bored and checking his phone.
On the first morning, he woke early and walked along the shore simply because he could not sleep, not expecting to find the quiet, empty beach as calming as it turned out to be.
Over the following two days, he found himself putting his phone away for longer stretches than usual, genuinely absorbed in watching the waves and listening to the sound of the water.
Driving home, Karim admitted to his wife that he had misjudged how much he needed this kind of quiet, and he suggested planning another trip sooner than either of them had expected.
